summary: Finished the export command: implemented --where evaluation, locale grouping and date/datetime patterns, CR LF CSV quoting per section 8, null placement in --sort, and .slice-NNN file naming for --max-rows; also made part-file reading split only on newlines. One existing test, test_split_into_files, still expects the old 'people-001.csv' names, which contradict docs/export.md section 10.3, so it fails and I did not change it.
